desc.Aspect of the Beast: The hunter takes on the aspects of a beast, becoming untrackable and increasing Melee Attack Power by 50. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

desc.Scare Beast: Scares a beast, causing it to run in fear for up to 15 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one beast can be feared at a time.

desc.Arcane Shot: An instant shot that causes 94 Arcane damage.
